AssignRolesRequest.description: Replace a membership's roles (§89). Ids must be roles in that scope.
AssignRolesRequest.title: AssignRolesRequest

BulkInboxStateRequest.description:
Apply the same inbox flags to several conversations for the caller.

Only provided flags are applied; passing ``folder: null`` explicitly clears
the folder assignment on every listed conversation.
BulkInboxStateRequest.title: BulkInboxStateRequest

CapabilitiesRequest.description:
Ask about many resources at once.

Actions ending in `.own` are evaluated with the caller as author, so a
granted `message.edit.own` means "you may edit messages you wrote". The
client must still compare `message.sender_id` before offering the action on
a specific item.
CapabilitiesRequest.title: CapabilitiesRequest

ChannelSummary.description:
The canonical shape for a channel appearing in a list.

One shape for every list context — the user's channels, a space's channels,
the channel inbox, the directory — so a client parses a channel the same way
everywhere. Readability is `visibility` and nothing else; there is no second
vocabulary for the same question.
ChannelSummary.title: ChannelSummary

ChannelView.description: The summary plus the policy and audit fields a detail view needs.
ChannelView.title: ChannelView

ChannelViewerStateView.description: The caller's own state on a channel, mirroring the conversation inbox row.
ChannelViewerStateView.title: ChannelViewerStateView

ConversationSendTextRequest.description: Conversation-scoped text send; the receiver is derived from the path.
ConversationSendTextRequest.title: ConversationSendTextRequest

DirectoryViewerBlock.description:
What the caller's relationship to a listed entity is.

Drives the join affordance, which is posture rather than permission: a
stranger and a pending applicant hold the same (empty) permission set but
need different buttons.
DirectoryViewerBlock.title: DirectoryViewerBlock

FeedPostView.description:
A channel message projected as a feed post.

Shares the underlying Message model but presents the fields a reader needs to
render a post rather than a chat bubble (author identity, attachments,
reaction summary, comment count).
FeedPostView.title: FeedPostView

FolderView.description: A user's folder, discovered from per-participant ``folder`` labels.
FolderView.title: FolderView

MessageTextStyle.description: Presentation for a short text body. Optional and additive.
MessageTextStyle.title: MessageTextStyle

OmniResults.description:
A bounded preview, deliberately unpaginated.

The typed endpoints are the paginated surface; this exists so one keystroke
can show a little of everything. Returning a cursor here would invite
clients to page through a shape that has no stable ordering across types.
OmniResults.title: OmniResults

SpaceChannelView.description:
A channel owned by a space (§21, §24).

``joined`` reports an explicit channel membership, which is distinct from
read access: a `members`-visibility channel is readable by any active space
member without one (§63).
SpaceChannelView.title: SpaceChannelView

SpaceGroupView.description:
A group conversation owned by a space (§21, §25).

Participation is always explicit — a space member is not implicitly a
participant — so ``joined`` is the authoritative membership signal here.
SpaceGroupView.title: SpaceGroupView

UpdateInboxStateRequest.description:
Per-participant inbox flags. Only provided fields are applied; passing
``folder: null`` explicitly clears the folder assignment.
UpdateInboxStateRequest.title: UpdateInboxStateRequest

UpdateParticipantPermissionsRequest.description:
Set or clear a member's granular permissions map. ``null`` clears it,
restoring pure role-based authorization.
UpdateParticipantPermissionsRequest.title: UpdateParticipantPermissionsRequest

UpdateParticipantRoleRequest.description: Assign a conversation role by name (a `roles` document in this scope).
UpdateParticipantRoleRequest.title: UpdateParticipantRoleRequest

ViewerBlock.description:
A cold deep link's first paint, in the same response as the resource.

Deliberately minimal: the full contract is `/viewer/capabilities`. This
exists so a client that has just fetched a channel can decide whether to
render an enabled composer without a second round trip. It is derived from
the same decision function, so it can never disagree with the full result.
ViewerBlock.title: ViewerBlock

post.description:
What the caller may do across a batch of resources.

POST rather than GET because a fifty-reference body does not belong in a
query string, and the answer is per-viewer, so nothing downstream could
cache it anyway. The batch limit is enforced by the request schema, which
returns 422 above it.
